findings.description: _store compares len(self._keys_by_country), the number of distinct countries, against max_entries. The cache holds up to max_entries rates, so the check should use len(self._entries). With a handful of countries the loop never runs, and every distinct (country, postal_code) pair is kept indefinitely. Expired entries are only replaced when the same key is looked up again, so memory grows with the number of distinct postal codes requested, and the cache_size setting has no effect. Eviction also only starts once the country count exceeds the limit, which is not the documented behaviour.
findings.suggestion: Change the loop condition to `while len(self._entries) > self._max_entries:`. Entries and _keys_by_country stay consistent because _evict_oldest removes the key from both.
findings.title: Eviction loop counts countries instead of entries, so the cache is effectively unbounded
